evidence.detail: rs/w/d owns multiple SoundEnvelope instances for pitch, volume, modulation and gating plus five oscillator voice parameter slots, echo/delay state, one SoundFilter and its filter envelope.

Its synthesis method renders an int[] sample buffer at the requested sample count/duration, evaluates oscillator waveforms, applies modulation/gating, mixes delayed voices, applies echo, then filters and clamps the final PCM amplitude range.

The decoder reads the paired envelopes, optional modulation/gating envelope pairs, up to five oscillator volume/pitch/delay triplets, delay/feedback, duration/offset, then SoundFilter plus its envelope.

candidates.note: Instrument is the conservative semantic name for this multi-envelope synthesized sound voice; it does not claim a verbatim original identifier.

evidence.detail: rs/w/e owns up to ten rs/w/d Instrument instances plus loop start/end timing and a static registry keyed by effect id.
Its mixer converts each Instrument duration/offset to 22050-Hz sample positions, calls Instrument synthesis, and sums the resulting PCM bytes into one shared output buffer.
The output method writes a canonical RIFF/WAVE header including RIFF, WAVE, fmt , mono 22050-Hz 8-bit PCM fields and data length before returning the Stream-backed WAV payload.
The static loader reads effect ids until 65535, decodes each SoundEffect from Stream, stores it in the registry and records its normalized start offset.

candidates.note: SoundEffect is the conservative semantic name for this instrument container/WAV mixer; it does not claim a verbatim original identifier.
